reference_scope: The reference is the themed Uno 6 parent before the Uno 7 migration. It is measured only on Skia. The older deployed UI at 067901c6396ca4a9cca2b335424c961a86f3cdf9 is not measured.

warmup_policy.reason: Both pinned Uno versions retain eligible stable visual subtrees after 50 paint frames

settings.graphics_description: SwiftShader software GPU API implementations; not physical GPU throughput

metric_semantics.aggregation: Medians of three trials within each original workload/backend runner. No pooling of frames, percentiles, or timing values across runners.
metric_semantics.task_wall_ms: Original metrics.cpu_ms.TaskDuration. Chromium 143 default timeTicks is elapsed task duration and can include blocking; this historical cpu_ms key is not active CPU time.
metric_semantics.active_renderer_thread_cpu_ms: Derived without rewriting artifacts: (cdp_cpu_after.ThreadTime - cdp_cpu_before.ThreadTime) * 1000. Active renderer-thread CPU; excludes descheduled waits and GPU/worker-thread CPU.
metric_semantics.elapsed_ms: Original timed offered-input workload window. It ends after two natural rAF opportunities, not a GPU drain or a guarantee of new pixels for every input.
metric_semantics.input_operations_per_second: Offered trusted-input operations divided by the original measured workload elapsed time. It is not physical presented FPS.
metric_semantics.completed_render_callbacks: Successful application animation callbacks that emitted visible-canvas graphics. They can replay older recorded work and do not count physical display presentations.
metric_semantics.diagnostics: One separate candidate-only instrumented trial per shard. Paint stopwatch values are elapsed callback durations; allocation totals include diagnostic observation. No baseline allocation ratio is available.
metric_semantics.post_window_queue_drain: Unavailable in this archived a44 harness. Later Graphite-only diagnostics do not retroactively change these measurements.
